screenLevelIssues.explanation: The input fields (Phone, Name) in the simulator are missing the distinct dark grey background color (#1A1A1A) and border radius (12px) defined in Figma. They appear transparent or blend into the main background.

The 'Get Started' button in the simulator lacks the Linear Gradient background (#202020 to #0D0D0D), the thin orange stroke (#FF9A6D, weight 0.1), and the drop shadow effects visible in Figma. It appears as a flat, disabled grey button.
screenLevelIssues.fixedCode: Use LinearGradient colors={['#202020', '#0D0D0D']}, borderColor: '#FF9A6D', borderWidth: 1, borderRadius: 8

screenLevelIssues.explanation: The background dotted texture/image is barely visible in the simulator. In Figma, 'Background Shape' has an image at 40% opacity with a gradient overlay, creating a visible texture. The simulator implementation is too dark or opaque.
screenLevelIssues.fixedCode: Ensure background image opacity is set to 0.4 and gradient overlay allows texture to show through.
